reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing link.ensureAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and the shared linkBankSyncAccount like the GoCardless handler, and the provider is wired into getServer, SYNC_PROVIDERS and syncAccount's dispatch.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the token/post/error/reshape body of the other provider download functions, which is how the tree writes each provider since no shared download helper exists.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, server path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching where each provider's pieces live.

scope.why: Focused on the provider, though it also widens DbAccount.account_sync_source to list the other existing providers, a small unrelated type fix.

maintainability.why: The link path is a thin call into shared code; the download function adds one more near-identical provider function to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; linkBankSyncAccount and the link module are used.

disguised_duplication.where: The download function openly follows the Akahu/Enable Banking pattern rather than disguising it.
